title: Characterization of Hermite degree indices
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers. An $n$-tuple $\alpha=(\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n)$ of natural numbers belongs to the set of Hermite degree indices of order $k$ exactly when $\sum_{i=1}^n\alpha_i\le k$.
